steps.name: expo-scaffold
steps.summary: Expo SDK 57 골격: package.json(name splito, main expo-router/entry, scripts lint/build/test/start, expo-dev-client, jest-expo·eslint-config-expo devDeps), app.json(name/slug/scheme 'splito', 템플릿 plugins), tsconfig.json(strict, @/*→./src/*, exclude supabase/functions·web), eslint.config.js(flat, eslint-config-expo/flat), jest.config.js(preset jest-expo), app/_layout.tsx(Stack), app/index.tsx('스플리토'), assets/(icon·splash·android·favicon·expo.icon); 템플릿 의존성(@expo/ui·expo-image·react-native-web 등)은 그대로 둠

steps.name: styling-tokens
steps.summary: NativeWind 4.2(Tailwind 3.4): tailwind.config.js(content app/**·src/**, nativewind/preset, colors sky 100~900 대체·ink·시맨틱 plus/minus/review-*/pending-*/done-*/line/divider/input-line, borderRadius md6/lg8/xl12/sheet16, fontFamily sans/medium/semibold/bold=Pretendard-*), global.css, babel.config.js(jsxImportSource nativewind + nativewind/babel), metro.config.js(withNativeWind input ./global.css), nativewind-env.d.ts(+jest types, *.css 모듈 선언); src/theme/tokens.ts(colors, radius, AVATAR_COLORS, MAX_FONT_SIZE_MULTIPLIER=1.3) + tokens.test.ts(tailwind 색상과 일치 검사); assets/fonts/Pretendard-{Regular,Medium,SemiBold,Bold}.otf + OFL.txt; app/_layout.tsx(global.css import, useFonts 로드, Text/TextInput defaultProps maxFontSizeMultiplier); app/index.tsx(bg-sky-100·text-ink-900); deps lucide-react-native·react-native-svg·nativewind, devDep tailwindcss@^3

steps.name: app-config
steps.summary: app.json 삭제 → app.config.ts(ExpoConfig; name 스플리토, scheme splito, portrait, light, APP_ID='app.splito'(가칭) = ios.bundleIdentifier·android.package, LINK_DOMAIN=EXPO_PUBLIC_LINK_DOMAIN ?? 'splito.vercel.app' → ios.associatedDomains applinks:·android intentFilters https host pathPrefix /i/ autoVerify, plugins expo-router·expo-secure-store·expo-font·expo-build-properties(ios 16.4)·expo-image-picker(카메라·사진 한국어)·expo-speech-recognition(마이크·음성인식 한국어)·expo-splash-screen); eas.json(development devClient internal apk / preview internal apk / production, cli.appVersionSource remote); .env.example(SUPABASE_URL·ANON_KEY·LINK_DOMAIN만); deps expo-secure-store·async-storage·expo-image-picker·expo-image-manipulator·expo-file-system·expo-clipboard·expo-speech-recognition(58.0.0)·expo-application·react-native-qrcode-svg·react-native-get-random-values·expo-build-properties. 주의: image-picker에 microphonePermission:false를 주면 speech-recognition의 NSMicrophoneUsageDescription이 지워짐. expo-doctor는 이 머신에 CocoaPods 미설치로 1건 실패(프로젝트 문제 아님)
